headline: Pierrakakis at the IMF: Greece among the 5 EU countries with a fiscal surplus
summary: Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis said Greece is among five EU countries with a fiscal surplus. He stressed European economic resilience and the need to accelerate reforms at the IMF annual meeting.
why: The IMF annual meetings bring together finance ministers and central bankers to discuss global economic outlooks, which shape sovereign risk assessments for investors.
